items.source: This parser follows the URL parsing algorithm in the WhatWG URL Living standard that browsers implement to align on lenient handling of user typed URL's that may not conform to RFC syntax.
items.translation: 此解析器遵循浏览器在 WHATWG URL 标准中实现的URL 解析算法，以实现对可能不符合 RFC 语法但由用户输入的非标准 URL 的宽松处理。

items.source: This parser type expects URI's to conform to RFC 3986 syntax.
items.translation: 此解析器类型要求 URI 符合 RFC 3986 语法。

items.source: Enum to provide a choice of URI parsers to use in UriComponentsBuilder.fromUriString(String, ParserType).
items.translation: 枚举，用于提供在 `UriComponentsBuilder.fromUriString(String, ParserType)` 中使用的 URI 解析器选项。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
